method: Native release, server-only /usr/bin/time -lp; reverse variant order every other round. Normalize CPU/instructions by wrk completed requests including warmup + readiness. Outstanding requests at wrk shutdown are not included. Shared developer machine; short exploratory runs, not isolated throughput claims. Response bytes and framing validated before each run; wrk checks HTTP/socket errors during load.
